title: equivalence
description: An adjoint pair F ⊣ G whose unit η : 1 ⇒ GF and counit ε : FG ⇒ 1 are natural isomorphisms — an adjoint equivalence of categories. Round trips return naturally-isomorphic, not equal, objects: the right notion of sameness for categories, and the seed of the weaker ∞-equivalences that replace strict isomorphism higher up. An adjunction refined by invertible unit and counit.

unit-counit-iso.description: the unit η and counit ε are natural isomorphisms (GF ≅ 1 and FG ≅ 1)
